title: Electrophysiological markers of surprise-induced failures of visual and auditory awareness
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 33 participants who completed counterbalanced visual and auditory surprise tasks designed to probe electrophysiological markers of surprise-induced failures of perceptual awareness. The data support an ongoing study by Leong et al. examining how unexpected stimuli disrupt conscious awareness across sensory modalities. Some participants' data are incomplete due to exclusion at various analysis stages.
methods_description: 33 participants completed both visual and auditory surprise tasks in counterbalanced order. EEG data were recorded using OpenBCI GUI v5.0.1. Note: recorded EEG values are 24 times larger than actual values due to incorrect GUI settings; units are in microvolts/24 as specified in channels.tsv files.
